families.name: Native Hashes
families.description: Jenkins-one-at-a-time hashes identifying each RDR3 script native function. Call them from Lua/C# via Citizen.InvokeNative or shorthand wrappers.
notes: Namespaces are Rockstar conventions; alloc8or/nativewrappers group them accordingly
When a native has no known name, use hex e.g. 0x554D9D53F696D002 directly

families.name: Model Hashes
families.description: Hashes for ped, horse, weapon, object, and vehicle models returned by GetHashKey(model_string) or joaat(model_string).
notes: Always include BOTH hash_hex and hash_dec in datasets; C#/Lua docs show hex, Cfx APIs often accept or print dec
Ped model names are case-sensitive: mp_male, UmmValgunsmith01, A_C_Deer_01, etc.

families.name: Blip Hashes / Sprites
families.description: Integer sprite IDs passed to SetBlipSprite() and color palette IDs passed to SetBlipColour().
notes: Sprite IDs are signed decimal integers in RedM Lua
See blips.json > sprites[] and blips.json > colors[] for enumerated values

families.name: Ped Component / Prop Collection Hashes
families.description: Hashes used for SetPedComponentVariation (drawable slots 0..11) and SetPedPropIndex (hat/glasses/watch etc.) and hair/beard/scars tints.
notes: Use GetNumPedDrawableVariations / GetNumPedTextureVariations at runtime per slot

families.name: Weapon Component / Attachment Hashes
families.description: JOAAT hashes used in GiveWeaponComponentToPed / HasPedGotWeaponComponent. Examples: 0x926612BA (scope), 0x0D7C5B9D (long barrel).
notes: Many attachments have COMPONENT_* string constants in femga's discoveries repo
Per-weapon whitelist enforced by the engine; test before assuming a component fits

families.name: Prompt Control / Mode Hashes
families.description: JOAAT control names passed to PromptRegisterBegin / PromptSetControlAction: `INPUT_CONTEXT_X` etc. Used directly or via ns-lib wrappers.
notes: See prompts.json for enumerated prompt slugs used by frameworks

families.name: Vehicle / Wagon Seat Bone Hashes
families.description: Bone IDs for GetEntityBoneIndexByName used by carriage/wagon scripts: `seat_front`, `seat_back`, `seat_hunter`, `door_hatch_l` etc.
notes: SCRIPTED_WAGON_MANAGER natives return bone-based seat indices

native_namespaces.name: Audio / Sound
native_namespaces.notes: Sound banks loaded via REQUEST_SCRIPT_AUDIO_BANK with alias strings from dat files

native_namespaces.name: AI Brain / Task Trees
native_namespaces.notes: Low-level task scheduling; most scripters use TASK namespace instead

native_namespaces.name: Camera
native_namespaces.notes: Always render with third bool=false to avoid head-clamping

native_namespaces.name: Clock / Time of Day
native_namespaces.notes: Combine with NetworkGetServerTimeMilliseconds for server-authoritative clocks

native_namespaces.name: Cutscene System
native_namespaces.notes: Requires registered cutscene RSC files streamed

native_namespaces.name: DataFile (DLC/Popcycle/etc.)
native_namespaces.notes: Useful for injecting custom popgroups without replacing originals

native_namespaces.name: Entity Decorator (K/V)
native_namespaces.notes: Register types ONCE before use; use stable string keys

native_namespaces.name: Entity (base of all)
native_namespaces.notes: Peds, horses, objects, wagons all expose ENTITY natives

native_namespaces.name: Game Event Handlers
native_namespaces.notes: Cfx overlay (not RDR3-native); used everywhere in RedM Lua

native_namespaces.name: Fire / Explosion
native_namespaces.notes: Avoid AddExplosion inside loops; radius cap enforced by engine

native_namespaces.name: Graphics / Draw / Texture
native_namespaces.notes: Only call Draw* while IsScreenFadedOut() is false and inside a render tick

native_namespaces.name: HUD / UI / Minimap
native_namespaces.notes: Use 0x9CB1A1623062F402 (SetBlipNameFromTextFile) for blip names via strings.gxt2

native_namespaces.name: Interiors / IPL
native_namespaces.notes: Sheriff jails, Valentine hotel, SD saloons all expose IPL entity sets

native_namespaces.name: Item Sets (spawn batches)
native_namespaces.notes: Used by pickups, area-loot, and horse-stable herd iterators

native_namespaces.name: Train Locomotives
native_namespaces.notes: Mission trains only; ambient trains are population driven

native_namespaces.name: Miscellaneous
native_namespaces.notes: Catch-all bucket; joaat() in Lua == GetHashKey

native_namespaces.name: Economy / Cash / Gold
native_namespaces.notes: Most RedM frameworks use SQL wallets; use Money_* only for temporary HUD-only transactions

native_namespaces.name: Object / Prop
native_namespaces.notes: Always set collision and freeze flags after placement

native_namespaces.name: Pathfinding / NavMesh
native_namespaces.notes: Async; wait after LoadPathNodeDataAtPosition before queries

native_namespaces.name: Ped (Human NPC)
native_namespaces.notes: Largest namespace. Humans and horses share many PED natives but horses have HORSE_* wrappers

native_namespaces.name: Physics / Force
native_namespaces.notes: ApplyForceToEntity uses boneIndex for non-center forces

native_namespaces.name: Player (Cfx PlayerId)
native_namespaces.notes: PlayerPedId() returns the local ped; GetPlayerServerId() = source ID

native_namespaces.name: Demo Recording / Replay
native_namespaces.notes: Developer tooling; disable in production menus

native_namespaces.name: Rope / Lasso / Tie
native_namespaces.notes: Must call RopeLoadTextures() before creating ropes otherwise they render invisible

native_namespaces.name: Scripting Infrastructure
native_namespaces.notes: Cfx overlay namespaced under SCRIPT for organizational purposes

native_namespaces.name: Shape Tests (Raycast)
native_namespaces.notes: Flags 511 = all intersect entities; flag 4294967295 = exclude self by convention

native_namespaces.name: Streaming (YMAP/YTD/...)
native_namespaces.notes: Always pair Request*/Has* loops with a timeout to avoid hang

native_namespaces.name: AI Tasks (high-level)
native_namespaces.notes: 2nd-largest namespace. Animations go through TASK too (TaskPlayAnim + TaskStartScenario)

native_namespaces.name: Train System (Mission)
native_namespaces.notes: Pairs with LOCOMOTIVE for scripting mission trains

native_namespaces.name: UI (Minimap/Prompts/Scaleform)
native_namespaces.notes: Prompt_* is RedM-only and not in base RDR3 nativedb; see femga discoveries

native_namespaces.name: Vehicle (Wagon/Carriage)
native_namespaces.notes: Vehicles = wagons, carts, carriages, boats. Horses are separate peds under PED + ANIMAL

native_namespaces.name: Weapon / Damage
native_namespaces.notes: WEAPON also covers ammo; ammo type hashes documented in weapons.json

native_namespaces.name: World Zones / Districts
native_namespaces.notes: Use GetNameOfZone(x,y,z) to display Valentine/Rhodes/Saint Denis/Blackwater names

hash_format_conventions.signed_dec_note: Cfx Lua prints model hashes as SIGNED 32-bit ints; convert to hex using (hash + 2^32) % 2^32 then to_hex for comparison

prompts.CheckPattern: while true do Wait(0); if PromptHasStandardModeCompleted(promptId, 0) then ... end end

native_invocation_pattern.named_wrapper_pattern: In VORP/RSC wrappers: exports.vorp_core:addBlip({sprite=-1230993421, name='Horse', x=1, y=2, z=3})

common_hash_lookup_tips: Search alloc8or.re/rdr3/nativedb/ by substring: e.g. 'prompt' finds all UI Prompt natives
For weapon component hashes: search femga/rdr3_discoveries 'weapon_components.txt'
For ped variations: use redm-natives-utils repo variation explorer (oakandrocks clone)
For animation dictionaries: search RDR3 animlist-exported.txt dumps shared on rdr2mods.com
